x-okf-proposal-guidance.summary: a versioned, dated train grouping the work that ships together.
x-okf-proposal-guidance.question: Does the source describe a set of changes shipping together under one version or date?
signals: a version number or target date is named
items are grouped by when they ship, not by what they do
release notes or a changelog are implied
anti_signals: the grouping is by outcome rather than by ship date
there is one change, not a train
no version or date governs it
x-okf-proposal-guidance.title_pattern: Names the release: `<package> vX.Y.Z`, `<Month YYYY> release`
